acceptance_repairs.given: A skipped-Consumer case is supplied to the success-evaluation process.

forbidden: The skipped-Consumer case is reported as successful.
oracle.observable: The executed evaluator result for the skipped-Consumer case.

acceptance_repairs.then: The skipped-Consumer case receives a terminal outcome other than success.

acceptance_repairs.given: An invalid package is supplied to the package-validation operation.

oracle.observable: The package-validation process exit status for the invalid package.

acceptance_repairs.then: Success is rejected for the invalid-package case.
acceptance_repairs.when: The package-validation process evaluates the invalid package.
